characters.name: Saint Brightbeard
characters.epithet: Patron Saint of Finding Your Keys

leaderSkill.name: They Were In Your Pocket
leaderSkill.desc: Light allies ATK x2 and REC x2.

activeSkill.name: Miraculous Locate
activeSkill.desc: Convert Dark orbs to Light orbs. Also reveals where you left your keys.

passive.name: Beatific
passive.desc: Light attacks against Dark enemies deal +25% damage.

awakened.epithet: Patron Saint of Finding Anything, Anywhere
awakened.abilityDesc: Miraculous Locate also heals the party and unlocks locked orbs. Nothing stays lost.

characters.flavor: Canonized after finding the King's keys, glasses, AND the remote in a single afternoon.

characters.name: Disco Oracle Yolanda

leaderSkill.name: Prophecy of the Beat
leaderSkill.desc: Light allies ATK x2.5 at 5+ combo. The floor lights up.

activeSkill.name: Mirrorball Judgment
activeSkill.desc: Deal Light damage to all enemies with 100% more sparkle.

passive.name: Foresight (Weekends Only)
passive.desc: First enemy attack each battle deals 30% less damage. She saw it coming.

awakened.abilityDesc: Mirrorball Judgment gains a full-screen cut-in and extends move time by 2 seconds. The beat never stops.

characters.flavor: Her crystal ball is a disco ball. Her prophecies rhyme. Her accuracy on Fridays is 100%.

characters.name: Lampwick Louie

leaderSkill.name: Beacon Rates (Hourly)
leaderSkill.desc: All allies HP x1.5. Light allies ATK x1.5.

activeSkill.name: Full Beam
activeSkill.desc: Deal Light damage and reveal enemy weaknesses this turn.

passive.name: Sturdy Base
passive.desc: Immune to knockback. He is a building.

characters.flavor: Quit the coast to 'follow the work'. Ships still write to him. He lights their letters fondly.

characters.name: Sister Glimmer

leaderSkill.name: Battle Hymn
leaderSkill.desc: Light allies REC x2. Combo 4+ adds a faint choir sound.

activeSkill.name: Crescendo
activeSkill.desc: Heal the party. The high note shatters one enemy's shield.

passive.name: Perfect Pitch
passive.desc: Heart matches charge Light skills too.

characters.flavor: Her choir has won wars. Technically they only sang, but the enemy retreated in tears.

characters.name: Glowworm Gus

activeSkill.name: Comforting Shine
activeSkill.desc: Heal the party a moderate amount. Fear of the dark: cured.

passive.name: Bioluminescent
passive.desc: Dark enemies deal 10% less damage to Gus.

characters.flavor: Charges by the night. Toddlers across the kingdom sleep soundly. Monsters under beds filed complaints.

characters.name: Halo Repair Technician Hank

activeSkill.name: Percussive Maintenance
activeSkill.desc: Deal Light damage. Have you tried turning the halo off and on?

passive.name: Insured
passive.desc: Takes 10% less damage from bosses. Liability coverage.

characters.flavor: Angels wait three weeks for an appointment. He shows up between 8am and 'eventually'.

characters.name: Slightly Magic Candle

activeSkill.name: Flicker
activeSkill.desc: Deal Light damage. It meant something, probably.

passive.name: Waxy
passive.desc: 5% chance to dodge. Slippery when warm.

characters.flavor: Sages have studied its flickering for decades. Current translation: 'draft from the window'.

characters.name: Jar of Fireflies

activeSkill.name: Swarm Sparkle
activeSkill.desc: Deal Light damage in many extremely small amounts.

passive.name: Ventilated Lid
passive.desc: The fireflies are fine. They're doing great. +5% HP.

characters.flavor: Seventeen rescued fireflies with seventeen rescue stories. They fight for the jar that saved them.
